about.title: Bɔt
about.intro: {project} na niu jenarayshɔn platfɔm fɔ peer-to-peer fayl shering we dɛn bil pan modan disentralayz teknɔlɔji. I de jɔyn yuza-frɛndli intafes wit fulli disentralayz akitɛkchɔ, we de bring sef ɛn riliebul data shering wit nɔ nid fɔ ɛni sɛntral atɔriti. Di prɔjɛkt na opin sɔs, we dɛn distribyut anda di {license}.

decentralized.title: Fulli disentralayz nɛtwɔk
decentralized.description: Nɔ sɛntral sava, nɔ wan pɔynt fɔ fel. Yuza dɛm de fɛn ɛn dawnlod kɔntɛnt dayrɛkt frɔm wan ɛn ɔda, witawt depɛnd pan ɛni sɛntral indɛksa, trakka, ɔ databes.

accessControl.title: Fayn-grein akses kɔntrol
accessControl.description: Anibɔdi kin start dɛn ɔn nɛtwɔk fɔ fri wit dɛn ɔn rul. Insay ɛvri nɛtwɔk, dɛfin yuza rol dɛm: ona, admin, pɔblisha, mɔdarɛta ɛn dawnloda. Kɔntrol fayn-grein udat kin pɔblish, mɔdarɛt, ɛn dawnlod kɔntɛnt.

ui.title: Hay-kwaliti yuza intafes
ui.description: Klin ɛn smut midia sɛnta intafes, dɛn dizayn am fɔ disktɔp, TV ɛn mobayl platfɔm. Iizi navigeshɔn wit kibɔd, maws, gemped ɔ rimot. Adva yuza dɛm kin run di software az ɛd-lɛs fayl sava wit kɔman-layn intafes.

dataFormat.title: Yuman-ridebul data fɔmat
dataFormat.description: Di LISH data fɔmat dɛn bil pan JSON, mek i izi fɔ kriet, rid ɛn ɔndastand. Sher yu kɔntɛnt wit klin ɛn transparent metadata we anibɔdi kin chɛk izi.

security.title: Praivasi ɛn sɛkyuriti
security.description: Ɔl peer-to-peer kɔmunikeshɔn dɛn enkript am, fɔ mek shɔ se yu data tan prayvit pan transmit. Yuza dɛm kin hayd biyen VPN fɔ ɛkstra anɔnɛmiti. {project} de rɛspɛkt yu praivasi bay dizayn.

crossPlatform.title: Krɔs-platfɔm
crossPlatform.description: Di software de pan Windows, Linux ɛn macOS. Yuz am pan ɛni divays we yu lɛk.
